messages:
maria-devex: Heads-up — planning a dry-run publish of the Python + TS SDKs in the 02:00 UTC quiet window tonight. Intention: exercise publish workflow, verify signed wheels and npm tarballs, validate ingestion in staging registries, and exercise pinback. Canaries will use `staging` tags. Who can watch?

sam-release: I can lead the publish. will do canary artifacts, push to staging index, then trigger integration smoke. tagging plan: py `1.12.0-canary.202703` / ts `1.12.0-canary.202703`.

neha-qa: I'll run the smoke suites after publish. plan: local install from staging, run basic auth/requests/streaming tests. expected 10–15m for warmup.

maria-devex: TL;DR publish steps below, then watch/rollback criteria.

sam-release: publish commands (dry-run first):
```
# python (build + dry twine upload to staging)
python -m build
twine upload --repository-url https://pypi.staging.redwood.ai dist/* --dry-run

# npm (dry-run, then real publish to dist-tag 'staging')
npm pack && npm publish --tag staging --dry-run
```

sam-release: after dry-run passes, will run real uploads:
```
# real publish (python)
twine upload --repository-url https://pypi.staging.redwood.ai dist/*
# real publish (ts)
npm publish --tag staging
```

deploy-bot: Canonical event: canary artifacts published. py=1.12.0-canary.202703 -> https://artifacts.redwood.ai/py/1.12.0-canary.202703, ts=1.12.0-canary.202703 -> https://artifacts.redwood.ai/ts/1.12.0-canary.202703 :eyes:

neha-qa: smoke start: installing from staging index... will post failures inline.

neha-qa: Quick smoke results: auth + basic requests OK, streaming example flaky (intermittent chunk reorder). attaching relevant log snippet:
```
2027-03-15T02:12:11Z INFO stream-client: opened connection
2027-03-15T02:12:13Z WARN chunk-order mismatch detected for message 42
2027-03-15T02:12:13Z INFO stream-client: falling back to legacy-stream-mode
```

julian-eng: thanks — that streaming instability is new in canary? compare with yesterday's baseline. if it's regression >3% it should block promotion.

neha-qa: baseline shows 0.2% flakes. canary currently 2.8% on same test. still within non-blocking margin but worth monitoring.

maria-devex: Rollback / pinback criteria proposal:
- Block promotion if functional regression > 1% absolute on critical smoke tests (auth/requests/streaming).
- Immediate rollback if visible customer-impacting errors: >5% 5xx on SDK usage in production or latency 2x median for >5min.
- Soft freeze and hotfix if deprecation logging causes noisy logs (>1000/min).

julian-eng: Add ops action: if rollback needed, re-tag `latest` -> previous release SHA and revoke `staging` tags. manual unpublish from staging registries. steps:
```
# pinback (npm)
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.11.5 latest
# pip: update index pointer / promote previous wheel to 'latest' by CI metadata
```

sam-release: Noted. Also: one more ask — include deprecation banner for the legacy sync client in this release notes. text suggestion: "Legacy synchronous client will be deprecated in next major (2.0). Please migrate to the async client; see migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/sdk/migrate-sync-to-async."

maria-devex: Agree. We'll include the deprecation note in the final candidate (canary only shows runtime warning for now). Add to release notes section: breaking changes = none; deprecations = legacy sync client warning.

ops-bot: Infra check: GPU inference fleet has no scheduled maintenance in the 02:00–04:00 UTC window. network deploy windows clear.

sam-release: After a 30m smoke/watch in staging with no regressions, we'll promote canary -> candidate and switch npm dist-tag `candidate` and mark wheels in internal registry. Promotion will be manual and announced here.

neha-qa: ack. I'll keep the smoke dashboard up and post any increases.

maria-devex: final runbook summary (short):
1) 01:58 UTC: preflight CI checks + build artifacts.
2) 02:00 UTC: dry-run publish -> if dry-run OK, real publish to staging (sam).
3) 02:02–02:35 UTC: QA smoke (neha). monitor telemetry.
4) 02:35–03:00 UTC: decision window. promote -> candidate OR execute pinback.
5) If rollback: perform dist-tag retarget + revoke staging artifacts + open hotfix PR.

maria-devex: can everyone please react with :thumbsup: to acknowledge and be on-call during the window? will proceed at 01:58 UTC if no objections.

julian-eng: :+1:
neha-qa: :thumbsup:
sam-release: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Ack — will post publish and promotion events here.
